usageBasis: Generated using the project ElevenLabs account; usage subject to its plan and terms.

like.prompt: One single soft tactile computer mouse click, a crisp dry tick with a tiny low pop. Immediate attack at the beginning, then silence. Minimal clean interface sound. No repeated clicks, no speech, no music, no ambience.

subscribe.prompt: One single polished interface confirmation sound: a crisp button click followed immediately by a short warm ascending two-note pop. Clean, restrained, satisfying. Immediate onset, short decay. No speech, no music, no ambience.

bell.prompt: One single gentle notification bell ding with a rounded bright attack and a soft short shimmering decay. Modern clean app notification, restrained and pleasant. Immediate onset. No repeated bells, no speech, no music, no ambience.
